lines: Other delivered libraries: 20, axios 1.17.0, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 0.24.0, dompurify 3.4.9, @floating-ui/dom 1.1.1, 1.7.6, semver 7.8.4, @floating-ui/core 1.7.5, and 14 more.

96 delivered files carry no source map, 3 files do. The bytes of the unmapped ones are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: a copy of a file of the checkout, the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
1 package is imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
